description_en: Mounts KVCacheInstance resources to the virtualization stack in batches
description_zh: 批量将 KVCacheInstance 挂载到虚拟化侧
name: AttachKVCacheStore

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The VSC ID pre-created on the compute side
fields.help_zh: 计算侧预创建的 VSC ID
fields.name: vsc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resources to mount. A maximum of 100 resources can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 挂载资源列表，最多 100 个
parameters.name: resource_ids

fields.help_en: The UID of the target account for role assumption
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:
service
user
fields.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The cross-account authorization role chain used for cross-account VSC resource verification
parameters.help_zh: 跨账号授权角色链，用于跨账号 VSC 资源验证
parameters.name: arns

parameters.help_en: A string generated by the server that serves as a unique identifier for the client request
parameters.help_zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识
parameters.name: client_token

Status.description_en:
The operation result. Valid values:
ATTACHING: The request has been accepted and the asynchronous mount is in progress.
ATTACHED: The resource is already mounted (idempotent).
Success: The synchronous verification passed and the asynchronous operation is complete.
Failed: The operation failed
Status.description_zh: 操作结果：ATTACHING（已受理，异步挂载中）/ ATTACHED（幂等：已挂载完成）/ Success（同步校验通过且异步完成）/ Failed（失败）
